# v0.10.0 — Persistent import sessions and visual mapping

2026-09-12 (UTC) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/yyyz1011/sheetdelta/releases/tag/v0.10.0)

## Changes

Parse each CSV/Excel file once in a persistent Worker, inspect worksheets and bounded previews, map unfamiliar headers, batch-repair source cells, generate reports on demand and collect full accepted rows only at delivery. React and Vue workbench examples cover the complete flow.

## Installation and upgrade

Install this version:

```sh
npm install sheetdelta-core@0.10.0
```

Review the [migration guide](../migration) and [related usage guide](../import-sessions) before upgrading. This is a summary of released changes, not a claim of support for every Excel feature.
